name: Dinosaur Park
description: Full-screen snap-scrolling zones, each with a colored background, staggered text reveal, accent link button, large dinosaur illustration, ghost counter number and a dot progress indicator.
contents: Full-height sections with eyebrow, two-line title, intro, accent link button and illustration
Large faded count number and section counter per section
Fixed dot indicator on the right edge
behavior: Inner container scrolls with vertical snap, one section per screen, scrollbar hidden
Section content slides in from the sides with staggered delays when a section is mostly visible and resets when it leaves
Dot indicator highlights the active section
Image side alternates per section through imgSide; sections stack into one column below 860px
editableByProps: Number of sections, all text, links, images, image side, background and accent colors
Visibility threshold that triggers the reveal

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the reveal slide distance or timing
needsCodeEdit.where: ENTER constant and ENTER_LEFT and ENTER_RIGHT

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image tint or glow
needsCodeEdit.where: filter style on the img element
link stylesheet element with the Google Fonts href

fixed: Loads Google Fonts Anton, DM Sans and Overpass Mono through link tags
Component is a full-viewport scroll container (h-screen) with its own snap scrolling
Dot indicator is fixed to the right edge of the viewport
Illustrations are inverted white silhouettes via CSS filter
